name: Profile-set joint forecast projection (one falsifiable rule)
stage: defined after minimal control passed, before candidate synthetic or market scores
forecast_set: parameters within c units of profile minus twice log likelihood on past window; heuristic plausible set, not coverage-certified confidence region
optimization: project zero onto convex hull of scaled three-horizon forecast corrections; equivalent to min_d max_j [||d-m_j||^2-||m_j||^2]
fallback: RW on solver failure with explicit log; failure rate above 0.001 blocks mechanism pass
other_markets: read and integrity-audited only; no switching after failure
historical_exposure: 2021-2022 previously inspected in StageC; not pristine test data
score: equal-year equal-horizon mean MSE/RW_MSE; same origins within each complete year
core_increment_baseline: best same-bank comparator chosen on tuning only
tuning_gate: Same numerical gain criteria; failure stops before reading validation outcomes
claims: No new-model, causal-state, chi-square-coverage or future-safety claim follows from a passing numerical gate. Generic convex forecast combination equivalence is explicitly tested.
